The Director does NOT adopt the broader reading of that ratio. The same packet documents, and the audit independently confirms, that RED is an item-blind FIFO BFS prefix that the frozen baseline-ordering proof forces to be >= RACQ_PATH, so the GROWING ratio is substantially a property of the level-order estimator's branching factor rather than independent evidence that the Web charges more for deeper instances (VN-V9; audit VF-03); the FLAT branch was producible only on the detour-free linear-chain calibration (R=2.0), while the direct persisted-path arm is near-linear in hop (requests ratio 2.0) and RACQ_URL is 1 GET for every item; and every admitted DEEP item is on doc.rust-lang.org (mdBook) with gnu/quotes/gentoo admitting 0 DEEP items within B=250/D=6, so cross-host/engine generalization is untested (VN-V8, VN-V13; audit VF-02). Consequently the packet measures the frozen estimator's output, not depth-growing Web acquisition economics, and it delivers no usable break-even or staleness input (the break-even reuse counts are all <<1 and follow from the ordering proof; audit VF-04). C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY is therefore held at EXPERIMENTAL with no advance: VALIDATED is barred because the claim's own subject matter was not measured, REJECTED is barred because no refutation is present, and this is not MEASUREMENT_INVALID because the control certificate, admission gate, session agreement and audit are all valid. promote_to_product=false (frontier, no product code, no mechanism authorized) and continue=false (the depth-scaling thread is now bounded at its estimator ceiling; a further level-order-BFS DEEP/NEAR run would be a same-basin repeat, and per research/portfolio/POLICY.md a lane Director produces a bounded handoff and a NEW experiment requires a Global Research Director mandate). The next question therefore moves to a materially orthogonal acquisition mechanism — site-native discovery — rather than re-scoring the estimator.
